## Scope and decisions

- Inputs: `Dulang A Well Schematic updated.pptx` (30 slides) and the six Excel workbooks for A04ST1, A11ST2, A17ST2 (updated), A23ST2, A26ST1 and A33ST3 (.xls).
- File naming: the request template says `DULANG-D<well-number><suffix>`; this is the Dulang **A** platform, so files are named `DULANG-A<number><suffix>.json` (leading zeros removed, explicit suffixes ST1/ST2/ST3 kept). The same name is the template well identifier (`wellInfo.name`); the original label is kept in this summary.
- PPTX vs Excel (user decision, 11 Nov 2026): where an Excel workbook exists for a wellbore slot, the Excel data is used and the PPTX slide revision is **superseded — not merged**. Superseded slides are listed below with their labels; their content is not in any JSON.
- Rules applied: ft = m × 3.28084 (3 dp) with original metres in `…M` keys; datums kept as printed (MDTHF / MDDF / MDRKB / MD DF never interchanged or shifted; off-datum values flagged); WLTHF (wireline) depths never used as MD; header sizes without an ID/OD designation recorded as ID (user rule, flagged); explicit MIN ID / MAX OD kept; diagram values preferred over conflicting header values (both recorded); tubular tops of 0 only on a tubing-hanger (THF) reference (flagged); no TD/PBTD substitution for tubular ends; nearest Type_Key mappings flagged with estimated / estimatedFields ['type'] / estimationNote / actualType.
